name: Maximum Largest Order Shattered Set of Singletons
proof: Apply downshifts in any coordinate order. The first shift replaces its coordinate singleton by the empty concept; every later shift leaves the other $n-1$ singletons unchanged because the empty concept is already present. The resulting downset is the empty concept together with $n-1$ singletons. Its largest shattered set has size zero for $n=1$ and one for $n\ge2$, independently of the order.
